# :studio_microphone: Introduction

This repository facilitates a workflow for researching, prompting, verifying, testing, and utilizing ai-generated audio effects for rnbo codebox.

- papers_library/ contains academic PDFs (mainly DAFx) that are downloaded with tools/fetch_papers.py and converted into a corpus with tools/build_corpus.py that can be explored with tools/search.py

- repos/ contains selected submodules of open-source fx to port from.

- generated_fx/ contains the ai fx. The fx are verified with tools/verify_codebox.js but not actually listened to by the ai. Some broken effects WILL generate DC offset or extremely loud sounds. 

- generated_maxpat/ and generated_v8ui/ are gitignored and generated by the scripts in tools/generate_maxpats.py and tools/generate_v8uis.py

- main_test_patcher.maxpat loads the generated maxpats and v8uis via file_list.html in jweb. Star ratings in jweb are saved to ratings.json

- The gh-pages branch contains one html file that displays data from generated_fx/ and ratings.json at https://aifx.sousastep.quest/ 

If you find an effect useful, consider donating to whoever is cited as the originator :pray:

This repository is vibecoded for free with freebuff.
